title: Achala Sentinel — Zero-Trust & AI Security Platform
seo_title: Achala Sentinel — Zero-Trust & AI Security Platform | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: Achala Sentinel, our Zero-Trust & AI Security Platform, protects people, machines and models with controls you can evidence.

blocks.x: Security architecture you can prove, not just promise. Achala Sentinel applies zero-trust controls to people, machines and AI models, and generates the evidence your auditors and regulators ask for.

Achala Sentinel is our Zero-Trust & AI Security Platform. It covers identity, device posture, network segmentation and, the part most vendors skip, the AI models themselves: prompt-injection defense, model access control and output monitoring.
Named modules, each with a clear job:

items: Every request authenticated, every device checked
Workloads talk only along declared paths
Prompt-injection defense, output filtering, model access logs
Control tests run continuously and file their own reports

blocks.title: Achala Sentinel — module topology
blocks.note: Modules are the platform's named components; trust lane is what the audit reads.

blocks.x: The platform is itself the evidence source:

items: Controls mapped to ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX and NIS2

blocks.x: Achala Sentinel runs in banking, insurance, healthcare, automotive and public sector estates, including TISAX-audited automotive supply chains and HIPAA-regulated healthcare data flows.
Integrates with your identity provider, SIEM and cloud estates. Model protection attaches to your AI serving layer without changing application code.
Bring one threat model to a briefing. We will show the controls, the tests and the evidence pack it maps to.
